scripts.build: npm run sprites && rm -rf dist && mkdir -p dist && cp index.html levels.js audio.js game.js dist/ && cp -R assets dist/assets
scripts.check: node --check server.js && node --check levels.js && node --check audio.js && node --check game.js && node --check functions/api/leaderboard.js && node --check functions/api/run.js && node --check scripts/rl/obs-encode.mjs && node --check scripts/rl/policy-infer.mjs
scripts.bot:level3: LEVEL=3 DURATION_MS=240000 HEADLESS=1 RECORD_VIDEO=0 node scripts/play-bot.mjs
scripts.rl:speedrun-loop:all: LEVELS=1,2,3 ROUNDS=6 EXPERT_EPISODES=3 POLICY_EPISODES=8 EVAL_TRIALS=2 DURATION_MS=200000 DURATION_MS_L3=280000 RECORD_WORKERS=3 LEVEL_PARALLEL=1 node scripts/rl/speedrun-loop.mjs
scripts.rl:speedrun-loop:l1: LEVELS=1 ROUNDS=8 EXPERT_EPISODES=4 POLICY_EPISODES=10 EVAL_TRIALS=4 FORCE_LEVELS=1 node scripts/rl/speedrun-loop.mjs
scripts.rl:seed-l1: LEVEL=1 EPISODES=8 SPEEDRUN=1 HEADLESS=1 WORKERS=2 node scripts/rl/record-demos.mjs
scripts.deploy: npm run build && wrangler pages deploy dist --project-name novawing
